== Biography ==

The Freeman’s Journal and Daily Commercial Advertiser reported two marriages at Paisley on the 25th ult: George Sherbrooke Airey, Esq., a Royal Navy lieutenant and son of the late Lieutenant-General Sir George Airey, to Anne, second daughter of the late Robert Glasgow, Esq.; and, at the same time, Rev. George Drake, son of Rev. John Drake, rector of Stourton, to Charlotte Maria Cecilia, youngest daughter of the late Robert Glasgow, Esq., of Montgreenan, Ayr. The 25 August 1847 date is inferred from ‘25th ult’ relative to the 2 September issue. The clipped passage does not include the issue header. Profile matches remain qualified; the notice names no mothers or Irish origins.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/401331272/ Freeman’s Journal and Daily Commercial Advertiser, 2 September 1847, p. 4, marriages], original passage visually checked; issue date and page verified separately.</ref>

== Research Notes ==

The printed wording is evidence for the two marriages and the stated father relationships at the level of the people named in the notice. The date 25 August 1847 is inferred from ‘25th ult’; it is not printed as a full date. The clipped passage does not show the issue header.

Candidate comparisons remain qualified. Robertson-30564 is the probable late Robert Glasgow of Montgreenan candidate: the 1847 notice calls Charlotte the youngest daughter of the late Robert Glasgow of Montgreenan; the 1827 birth notice places an unnamed daughter of Mrs Robertson Glasgow at Rome; a profile-cited 1841 census transcription lists Robert Glasgow with Charlotte, age 10, though that census has not been independently checked. The existing Montgreenan succession account connects Robertson-30564 (Robert Robertson, later using Glasgow; died 1845) with the estate. This evidence supports the candidate beyond the current tree links, but does not prove the identity. Glasgow-1076 (1747–1827) remains a weaker possible alternative because his death before 1847 is compatible with “late”; no reviewed evidence definitively excludes him. Anne Glasgow-3000 is possible; Charlotte Glasgow-3003 is strongly compatible by names, current Drake surname and 1827 birth; Rev George Drake-13873 is probable by name/title and the existing spouse link. No compatible profile for George Sherbrooke Airey was located in the bounded local search.

The previous local Open-profile summaries showed these existing tree links as unknown (tree-only), with no evidence IDs: Robertson-30564 as father of Glasgow-3000 and Glasgow-3003 (generated claims with provenance wikitree_parent_field), and Drake-13873 as spouse of Glasgow-3003 (generated claim with provenance wikitree_spouse_field). Those prior assessments describe the state of the evidence before this notice; the tree links themselves are not documentary proof. The record-level father and spouse statements are direct, but their application to the profile candidates remains pending identity confirmation. No profile relationship upgrade is claimed or applied. No mother is named or assessed.

Next checks: independently identify George Sherbrooke Airey and verify the Anne and Charlotte candidate assignments using biographical, naval, clerical, baptismal or marriage records. Reassess candidate relationship status only after identity is established.
